name: Google Ads
description: Google Ads lets advertisers create and manage ads; the Google Ads API automates campaign management.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user flows or service accounts via Google Cloud project; a Google Cloud project access level is required for production.
gate_detail: Production use needs a Google Cloud project with an API access level (Explorer, Basic or Standard); Standard goes through application review. API is free; Test access covers test accounts only.
api_scope: Programmatic management of Google Ads accounts, campaigns and reporting via the Google Ads API, with client libraries; also Google Ads scripts.
mcp_notes: Google Ads MCP server bridges AI agents to the Google Ads API; local stdio or remote streamable-http.
blocker_detail: Access levels are granted by application review; Standard review can take days to weeks, and Explorer limits daily operations and some features.

evidence.quote: the Google Ads API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
uses an application review process to grant various access levels.
The Google Ads API is free to use; there are no charges for using the Google Ads API at Explorer access, Basic access, or Standard access levels.
The Explorer access level allows your Google Cloud project to execute up to 2,880 operations per day against production accounts.
The Google Ads MCP server provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API.
Use webhook to send data from Google Ads to your CRM system.

issues: Webhook is for lead form data, not general API events.
MCP URL not stated; local stdio install shown.
REST style not explicitly stated; reference is RPC.
